rationale: The plan fits the design: DESeq2 Wald on raw Salmon gene counts, 3v3 unpaired single batch with no batch term, edgeR QL as a robustness check, an explicit low-power caution at three replicates with alpha kept at 0.05 rather than loosened. Blind-VST PCA and distance heatmap colored by condition precede the test with a stated no-silent-drop outlier policy, the filter (>=10 counts in >=3 samples) is minimal and justified, normalization is median-of-ratios inside the model, and BH at 0.05 with independent filtering plus apeglm shrinkage is specified with thresholds passed to results(). The reference level and named contrast are explicit, but the design formula itself is never written out (only referred to), and one constraint line (test_against_threshold) contradicts the stated zero-null test. Enrichment is correctly omitted, and the report specification covers method, versions, design, thresholds, n_tested, n_DE, caveats, and sessionInfo.
